title: Chapter 772 Thank You For Helping!
content:
Chapter 772 Thank You For Helping!

Chapter 772 Thank You For Helping!

On a mountain road.

The group of people fled in panic, their faces filled with panic.

"Run!"

"Hurry up!"

The woman with a better figure kept panting,"I..." I can't take it anymore. You guys run first."

"What nonsense are you talking about? Hurry up and run!"

"Let me help you!"

"I'll help too!"

As the few people beside him spoke, they picked up the woman and continued running forward.

However, just as they were talking, a group of men in black had already caught up to them.

"Die!" they said viciously.

As soon as he finished speaking, long sabers swept through sharp astral winds and slashed at the few of them.

Even though the saber had not yet landed, the few of them could already feel a bone-piercing chill that made them feel despair.

The few of them had no doubt…

In the next moment, he would be cut in half and his head would be separated from his body.

The few of them could not help but close their eyes.

However, they did not feel any pain for a long time. They could not help but slowly open their eyes.

Only then did he realize that the group of men in black had all fallen to the ground at some point in time. It was unknown if they were dead or alive.

However, there was a tall and handsome man in front of them.

He... It was Lin Fan.

"It's fine now." Lin Fan said.

" Thank you, Young Master." The few of them came back to their senses and bowed respectfully." Thank you for saving me."

Lin Fan said," No need to thank me. I didn't save you for nothing. I need a pearl from you."

He spoke very directly without beating around the bush.

Otherwise, even if he saw someone being chased, he wouldn't have casually attacked.

After all, there were too many grudges in this world.

If he were to take care of everything, wouldn't he die of exhaustion?

The few of them were stunned.

"Young hero, do you want this bead?" The woman with the better figure asked.

As she spoke, she took out a gray bead.

Lin Fan nodded," That's right, that's it."

The woman handed it over without hesitation.

Even though this pearl was very important to her.

Lin Fan willed the pearl into his body.

Thus, he had gathered four orbs.

The woman hesitated for a moment and said,"This…" Young hero, can you take us back to the capital? At that time, I will send you a generous reward."

Rich reward?

Even if he were to give this planet to Lin Fan, he wouldn't mind at all.

However, the other party had just given him a pearl, so it was fine to help him.

"Sure," Lin Fan said.

"Thank you, young hero!" The woman said happily.

Along the way, she had suffered too many snipers and dangers.

She had already experienced the moment when she was almost killed by the men in black several times.

Every time, they used their lives to fill the gap.

As a result, they were originally a team of 100 people.

Now, there were only a few of them left.

Originally, she had already given up on the idea of returning to the capital alive.

However, Lin Fan's appearance gave her hope again.

Now that he had obtained the pearl, Lin Fan was not in a hurry. He strolled along with the others and could be considered to be admiring the scenery of the other world.

After a long conversation, Lin Fan found out that the woman with a good figure was called Jiang Xiaoyue. She was the daughter of the boss of Hao Lai on Aierxing.

Good Again was the largest trading company on Planet Hailin. It was no joke that its wealth could rival that of a country.

There was a tradition in Hao Lai, which was to let their children, who were 16 years old, take a certain amount of start-up funds to go out and make a living.

With three years as a cycle, they would be evaluated and ranked based on the wealth they earned.

Those with a higher ranking would receive preferential resources from Hao Zai Lai, and the most outstanding ones would have the chance to inherit Hao Zai Lai.

This was a method of cultivating Gu. At the same time, it was also the reason why Hao Zai Lai continued to develop and grow.

Not long after, it was the time for a cycle of assessment.

Jiang Xiaoyue's performance in the past three years was extremely outstanding, which made her other brothers and sisters jealous.

Of course, if it was just these brothers and sisters, it would not be too dangerous.

This was because Haozai forbade anyone from hurting each other.

Once they were found out, they would be severely punished.

The important thing was that the boss of Hao Zai had died of a serious illness not long ago.

Some of the enemies of Good Again took the opportunity to make trouble, which led to the crisis.

Lin Fan had read about such grudges in novels before, so he wasn't too surprised.

He only chatted with Jiang Xiaoyue casually, his eyes constantly moving on the scenery of the other world.

What kind of eyesight did Jiang Xiaoyue have?

She could easily tell that Lin Fan's thoughts weren't on her but she wasn't angry.

On the contrary, he would prepare drinking water for Lin Fan and roast meat for him. He was like a servant.

Half a month later, the Imperial Capital appeared before everyone.

Jiang Xiaoyue and the others all smiled.

" Young hero Lin, please come back and take a rest. I will thank you later."

Lin Fan said," It's fine if you want to thank me. I'll help you again."

Help?

Jiang Xiaoyue and the others looked puzzled.

They had already arrived at the capital, so they could come back to the base camp.

Why would he need help?

"Ta!"

As if in response to Lin Fan, a large group of men with sharp blades rushed out and surrounded everyone, including Lin Fan.

"Second Miss Jiang, long time no see." The leader, a man in a green robe, laughed sinisterly.

When Jiang Xiaoyue saw him and the two men beside him, her pupils constricted slightly.

" Green-faced King, Deadly Twin Beasts!"

There was a Heaven List on El Planet, which recorded the top 100 experts.

Every expert here possessed incomparably terrifying strength.

The Green-faced King and the Deadly Twin Beasts were the powerhouses on the Heaven Roll!

Especially the Green-faced King, who was ranked top 20 on the Heaven List!

Any one of these three people could make people afraid, but now, a total of three had appeared!

It was simply despair!

A person's name, a tree's shadow.

When the three people's names were mentioned, the people around Jiang Xiaoyue could not help but take a few steps back.

Jiang Xiaoyue said to Lin Fan," Young hero Lin, you have nothing to do with us. Let's go."

It had to be said that this Jiang Xiaoyue still had some loyalty.

At this moment, the first person he thought of was Lin Fan.

Lin Fan shook his head," You haven't thanked me. I can't leave yet."

Jiang Xiaoyue was stunned for a moment and was about to speak again.

" Alright," the Green-faced King said from a distance." There's no need to say anymore. None of you will be leaving today."

"Kill them!"

" Die!" he shouted, emitting an extremely ferocious aura.

The men in black behind him raised their blades and slashed at Jiang Xiaoyue, Lin Fan, and the others.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan only let out a light snort.

"Humph!"

A powerful sound wave spread out with Lin Fan as the center.

"Puff!"

"Puff!"

Instantly, the men in black who were rushing over were sent flying as if they had been hit by a speeding car. They spat out a large mouthful of blood in the air and fell to the ground, completely unable to move.
